decisions.reason: As an indoor air quality sensor module, it fits the firm's modular sensing platform and in-house electronics and firmware capabilities, so early learning and improvement are feasible.
This is a direct next-generation replacement of an existing voltage measurement module, making it highly related to the firm's prior knowledge and therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
A software proxy for MQTT communication builds on the firm's strong software bindings, APIs and connectivity focus, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to refine it commercially.
A CAN bus interface module is close to the firm's established communication and control offerings for embedded and automation customers, which supports continued development rather than exit.
A carbon dioxide sensor module is well within the firm's sensing and modular hardware knowledge base, though its narrower use case gives it a slightly higher withdrawal risk than core platform items.
The touch panel accessory still complements the platform, but as a more peripheral accessory than core sensing or interface modules it is somewhat more exposed if demand proves weaker.
